messages:
hana_cs: Quick draft: one-page priming + feedback flow for Meridian (renewal demo). Need AE-friendly bullets + two pasteable snippets. PTAL.

omar_eng: Keep it skimmable. Paste the checklist here.

hana_cs: TL;DR checklist: 
- Goal: demo feels instant and repeatable; reduce renewal risk.
- Owners: CS (hana_cs) + Eng (omar_eng).
- 48h: request warm pool sized to 95th pct concurrency.
- 8h: run prefill using tenant prompts + exact system-prompt variant.
- 1h: full dry-run (streaming on).
- Live knobs to suggest to customer: prefill_ttl_sec=3600; batch_hint={batch_size:8,max_latency_ms:50}; enable_stream=true, stream_fallback_ms=200.
- Obs: confirm FB latency <150ms and capture last-3 prompt traces.
- Feedback capture: 3-question survey (tiny.redwood/feedback-meridian) + opt-in to attach up to 2 anonymized transcripts. Consent copy: "I consent to anonymized transcript review for quality improvements."
- Escalation/rollback: if 95th latency >220ms OR hallucination spike -> switch to fallback model variant, rollback prefill, notify CS-oncall + infra.

lucy_ae: Add AE one-liner risk: "Risk: renewal sensitive to latency & quality; mitigation: warm-pool + prefill + rollback plan."

mike_support: Ops prefill curl (copy):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/prefill" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant":"meridian","prompt":"demo-seed","pool_size":10,"ttl_sec":3600}'
```

omar_eng: Customer drop-in JSON for integrators: 
```json
{"batch_size":"8","max_latency_ms":"50","enable_stream":"true","stream_fallback_ms":"200"}
```

ops_bot: Reminder: reserve dedicated capacity 2024-11-26T14:00:00Z for tenant 'meridian' — reply :thumbsup: to confirm.

hana_cs: Thanks all. I'll run the dry-run Thu 15:00 with Omar + Mike then send one-pager to AE. Leaving this thread as the canonical mini-runbook + snippets + escalation path. :white_check_mark:
